title: Saved confirmation appears without a status role
description: Saving a draft reveals a confirmation paragraph that was hidden. There is no live region and no focus move, so the visible confirmation is silent for assistive technology.

relatedElements.note: An always-present role=status region whose text is updated.

expectedBehaviour: A status message that appears after an action is announced without moving focus.
actualBehaviour: The message is inserted into a plain paragraph that was hidden; no live region or role=status exists.
userImpact: Screen-reader users do not learn that the save succeeded and may repeat the action or assume it failed.

observed.note: Page-level axe run with tags wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa and best-practice. No violation was reported for this page in its default state; the control on the same page also passes.

detection.note: Static analysis cannot prove the absence of an announcement; a screen-reader check or a live-region heuristic is required.

manualTests: Turn on a screen reader, activate Save draft and listen for a confirmation.

assistiveTechnologyTests.procedure: Navigate to the target with the VoiceOver rotor and confirm what is announced.

assertions: The confirmation paragraph has no role and is shown by removing the hidden attribute.
tests: tests/subtle-defects.spec.js: keeps the silent confirmation in variant A

reviewStatus.note: A Playwright regression test preserves the defective behaviour and its control. That is automated reproduction, not a manual or assistive-technology observation.
